sources.title: On the Distribution Function of Additive Functions
sources.read_scope: Original definition p.1; theorem announcement p.3; Theorem XI and closing proof pp.17–18.
sources.supports: Known logarithm characterization for monotone additive arithmetic functions.
sources.limit: Our elementary power sandwich proof assumes complete additivity, a stronger hypothesis, and does not re-prove the general coprime case.

sources.title: The Riemann Zeros and Eigenvalue Asymptotics
sources.read_scope: Equations (2.6), (2.17)–(2.18), nearby convergence and amplitude discussion.
sources.supports: Divergent raw prime expansion in critical strip and amplitude/sign problems in orbit analogy.
sources.limit: Not an established spectral realization or proof of RH.

sources.title: Hecke Algebras, Type III Factors and Phase Transitions with Spontaneous Symmetry Breaking in Number Theory
sources.read_scope: pp.32–33, equations (3)–(5) and theorem25 setup, H epsilon_n=log(n) epsilon_n.
sources.limit: The algebra is arithmetically specified; this does not derive prime weights from unmarked composition.

proof_scope: Written classification and monotone rigidity proof for all positive integers; explicit independent-circle example; finite symbolic checks supplement proof, not replace it.
